title: OccJEPA: Occlusion as Masking for Amodal Video Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Amodal video segmentation asks for the complete mask of an object in every frame, including the parts hidden behind other objects. The best current methods generate these masks with fine-tuned video diffusion models, which need many denoising steps and an extra depth network, and give a different answer for every sample. Self-supervised video world models of the JEPA family are trained on a closely related task: predicting the representation of masked space-time regions from the visible ones. We therefore treat occlusion as masking. The tokens that the object's visible mask does not cover are dropped, the pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 predictor fills them in, and a light head decodes the observed and predicted features into amodal masks. translated_title: OccJEPA：将遮挡视为掩码的完整视频分割
translated_abstract: 完整视频分割要求预测每帧中物体的完整掩码，包括被其他物体遮挡而隐藏的部分。目前最好的方法使用微调后的视频扩散模型来生成这些掩码，但这类方法需要大量的去噪步骤和一个额外的深度网络，且每次采样给出的结果都不同。JEPA 家族的自监督视频世界模型是在一个密切相关的任务上训练的：从可见区域预测被掩码遮蔽的时空区域的表征。因此，我们将遮挡视为掩码：物体可见掩码未覆盖的 token 被丢弃，由预训练的 V-JEPA 2.1 预测器填补这些 token，然后通过一个轻量级头将观测到的和预测的特征解码为完整掩码。由此得到的模型 OccJEPA（Occlusion-as-masking JEPA）是确定性的，比基于扩散的最先进方法快 33.5 倍，并且在 SAIL-VOS 和 TAO-Amodal 上（包括保留测试集）更加准确。
tldr: OccJEPA 将视频中的遮挡视为掩码任务，利用预训练的 V-JEPA 2.1 预测器填补被遮挡区域并解码出完整掩码，实现了确定性的完整视频分割，比基于扩散模型的最先进方法快 33.5 倍且精度更高。
en_tdlr: OccJEPA treats occlusion as masking, using a pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 predictor to fill in occluded tokens and decode amodal masks, achieving deterministic amodal video segmentation that is 33.5x faster and more accurate than diffusion-based state-of-the-art methods.
